snippet.title: Dreadmoor | Secret Sauce Showcase trailer
snippet.description:
Dreadmoor has unveiled a new trailer, alongside an October 6 release date for its first demo. The full game is coming out on PC Q4 2026.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3629430/DREADMOOR/

Secret Sauce Showcase Steam Event: http://obp.gg/secretsauce2026
